name: OfferEvo
description: Customers create offers for local businesses. Businesses approve them before they go live, and people discover, share and use them in store with a QR or eight-character code.
features: Customers create discounts and deals for local businesses
Businesses approve each offer before it goes live
Anyone can discover and share approved offers
Offers are redeemed in store with a QR code or eight-character code
One account for customers and business owners
